findings.summary: Custom decision answer 'Re-run once with a human reviewer — Alex, 2026-08-12 ("final" attempt #4)' survived submit, page reload, and a fresh new-tab session byte-for-byte — em dash, quotes, and ordering all intact.

Undo works as promised: taking back 'Raise the attempt cap' within the 10-second window restored the decision to pending with all four options and the Deck badge count, and re-answering cleared it cleanly.

Answering the spot-check verdict ('Looks right') leaves no entry in the Answered history and offers no undo window, unlike decisions — the verdict disappears with no visible record or take-back, an asymmetry a user may read as lost data.
